name: Phone Control
author: apsingh
description: scrcpy UHID control: left-click summons the phone capture window from the scratchpad (Alt on the keyboard releases the mouse back to the PC); right-click starts/stops the scrcpy service.

barWidget.description: Control the Android phone via scrcpy UHID. Click to summon/hide the capture window from the scratchpad; right-click to start or stop scrcpy.
